in_marathi.name: Mahipal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahipal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahipal is a Sanskrit name for the Hindu deity Mahadev, who is the god of war and destruction. The name Mahipal is derived from the words 'maha' meaning great and 'pal' meaning protector or guardian. It is believed that Mahipal protects his followers from their enemies and helps them overcome obstacles in life.

vedic_reference.note: Mahipal is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahi', which means 'great', and 'Pal', which means 'Vishnu'. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is one of the primary gods, and is responsible for maintaining the balance in the universe. By using the name Mahipal, one invokes the blessings and protection of this powerful deity.
